atoms.text: First, he talked to the Bronsons. They were neighbours and had always been friendly. “Mr Bronson!” Knut called, “The bridge briars have attacked our bridge and are eating away our bridge glue. We’re losing structure. You should check your bridge now and see if they’re attacking yours too.”

We’re losing structure. You should check your bridge now and see if they’re attacking yours too.”</voice>

atoms.text: Mr Bronson and his family looked sceptical. The bridge briars were just a legend. They didn’t exist! He and his daughter went below their bridge only to come out several moments later with shocked expressions on their faces.
“It’s true, I see the dust falling from our own glue. We have to warn people!”

Knut’s mission continued. He stopped at every bridge and without fail, each bridge was being attacked from underneath. Each troll was shocked to see the structure of their bridge undermined by these near invisible mites eating at the core.
At this point, Knut had a following. Many people followed him on bikes from bridge to bridge, either to support him or to see the shocking evidence over and over again.

Finally, they arrived at the last bridge. This bridge was owned by the McTrolls. They had won the competition for as long as most trolls could remember and were the favourites for this year as well. Knut began his speech that was by this time well-practised.
atoms.sound: Finally, they arrived at the last bridge. This bridge was owned by the McTrolls. They had won the competition for as long as most trolls could remember and were the favourites for this year as well. Knut began his speech that was by this time well-practised.

atoms.text: He finished explaining about the briars, and Mrs McTroll sneered, turned up her nose and said, “don’t be a fool! There are no briars. If your bridges are crumbling, perhaps you should have taken better care. We will NOT be checking our bridge, and you may not either. Please leave. We are preparing ourselves mentally for the last task.” And with that, she turned her back and walked away.

If your bridges are crumbling, perhaps you should have taken better care. We will NOT be checking our bridge, and you may not either. Please leave. We are preparing ourselves mentally for the last task.”</voice> And with that, she turned her back and walked away.

atoms.text: Knut turned and looked at the group who had been riding with him. They all seemed annoyed and irritated, just as he imagined he looked. “Why wouldn’t she at least look?” he asked.
“Mighty strange if you ask me,” answered Mrs Trollstone. “This no longer seems like a fair competition. We are going to talk to the Spanning Society.”

atoms.a: Which word could replace sceptical in the second paragraph?
Why won’t Mrs McTroll look under her bridge?
b: She doesn’t want her feet to get wet.
She is too afraid of the briars.

atoms.a: Why does Mrs Trollstone want to talk with the Spanning Society?
b: She wants to tell them how much she enjoys the contest.
She wants to judge the competition.
++She feels the contest may no longer be fair.
